rows.text: Esteemed guest, the Garmentmaker in "Eternal Holy City" Okhema can no longer detect any more nymphs
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: But a plethora of butterflies just appeared in the "chrysalis room"
rows.speaker: Aglaea

rows.text: Come take a look at the Garmentmaker's when you can
rows.speaker: Aglaea
